programme.desc: On the outskirts of Hamilton, Ontario, a jogger makes a gruesome discovery – the partially mummified remains of a human body. Using state of the art forensics, police are able to identify the body as that of a suburban wife and mother of two. She has been brutally bludgeoned to death, but no missing person’s report has ever been filed. As police investigate, they discover evidence of domestic strife, including a love triangle and charges of assault. Determined to find the killer, police dig further into the victim’s life, doggedly tracking down a former lover to New York City, where they uncover another crime. programme.title: Forensic Factor
programme.desc: A series of over sixty spectacular fires rips through California’s San Joaquin valley, killing four people and devastating the landscape. An extensive investigation by the ATF, police and forensic scientists reveals a common pattern among all the blazes, and to their horror, authorities soon realize that a serial arsonist is on the loose. As they painstakingly study the evidence from each crime scene, a single fingerprint leads them to one suspect. He is John Leonard Orr, a respected arson investigator for the Glendale Fire Department in Southern California and one of the worst serial arsonists of the 20th century.

programme.title: Forensic Factor
programme.desc: A double homicide in Hudson, Wisconsin leaves a small town reeling and two young detectives with little to go on. The victims are upright citizens, shot execution style, with no apparent motive. In Agatha Christie-like fashion, a tantalizing array of suspects emerge but after two years, there are still no arrests. Richard Walter, the famed criminal profiler, becomes intrigued by the cold case and narrows the suspect list down until only one man is left standing. And no one can believe who that person is. A combination of expert crime scene analysis, computer forensics and the perpetrator’s own pathological urge to talk… the bereaved families finally see justice served.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The new series Dahmer - Monster: The Jeffrey Dahmer Story may have landed the number one spot on Netflix, but it wasn’t popular with everyone. Angry family members of Dahmer’s victims say the controversial drama re-traumatized them and romanticized the notorious serial killer. You’ve seen Hollywood’s version. Today, Dr. Phil is telling the real story and meeting the real people who say they knew the real monster that was Jeffrey Dahmer. In an exclusive interview, hear from the sister of one victim who says the series glorified the man she calls “Satan,” as well as two men who say they were tortured and terrorized by Dahmer and survived.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Victims and survivors of Jeffrey Dahmer say they want people to see him for who he really was -- not the glamorized TV version. See a never-before-aired interview with Dahmer’s father and stepmother that sheds light on the monster behind the man. They provide chilling details about his bizarre childhood behaviors. Plus, the Netflix series Dahmer - Monster: The Jeffrey Dahmer Story pushed a decades-old story into today’s spotlight, some say giving it a 2022 “pop culture moment.” After the series debuted, Dahmer’s infamous glasses went up for sale for $150,000, and people dressed up as the notorious serial killer for Halloween. Has our culture’s obsession with true crime desensitized us?

programme.desc: This Dr. Phil Family is angry, out of control, and about to get an intervention in The Dr. Phil House. Melissa, 22, wrote to Dr. Phil for help for her self-destructive family. Her mother, Myra, and her stepfather, Gene, have a long history of betrayals, infidelity, anger and years of bitter resentment. Melissa says her family even turns special occasions into volatile disasters with turkey dinners and Christmas trees being thrown across the room. The fighting got so bad, Melissa says she had to move away from her extreme family. Her brothers, Edwin, 20, and Eugene, 17, attest that their home is a war zone, and that they have witnessed fights between their parents that involve name-calling, spitting and dousing each other with water, all in front of their 7-year-old brother. Myra says she can’t forgive Gene for his four affairs, but especially the last one, which was with a 19-year-old. Over three years have passed since Gene’s last affair, but Myra still calls him a pedophile every chance she gets, and says she’d leave if it weren’t for their youngest child. Can this family learn to stop the drama, heal their anger and start over with a healthy foundation, or should they call it quits for good?

Kevin strongly denies having an inappropriate relationship with Grace, and claims he’s just trying to be a father figure since Grace’s dad passed away. But is there something more?

programme.title: Dr. Phil

Gene and Myra attempt to talk to Melissa about her weight, but Melissa is anything but receptive. Then, because they often blame each other for the chaos in the family, Melissa and Gene are assigned to bury the hatchet long enough to cook a family dinner together, without help from anyone else. Will these relatives be able to follow the rules? After dinner, a family meeting turns heated with accusations and tearful confessions. programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: After all their hard work, the latest Dr. Phil Family receives some surprises from Dr. Phil! He informs Melissa that everything she needs to get her life back on track is headed her way: a complete health evaluation, personal trainer, nutritionist, and food service delivered to her door. In addition, she’ll receive help for her depression and be connected with a developmental disabilities specialist for her autistic son. But it all comes with a condition: Melissa and Randy need to heal their toxic relationship. Then, a talk with Myra and Gene leads to a tearful apology. And, will a one-on-one with Dr. Phil’s wife, Robin, help Myra see that she deserves to be treated with dignity and respect? Will Myra set some standards in her broken marriage? Will there even be a marriage to speak of when they get home? Dr. Phil has some strong words for Gene. Next, a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity pits brother against brother as Edwin and Eugene audition for a Hollywood talent agent and a casting director. Don’t miss the surprising twist when they get a call from the judges. Then, it’s time to switch gears – literally! Since Myra and Melissa never learned to drive, Dr. Phil sets them up with a driving lesson so they can become more independent. And you won’t believe the prize in store for the women if they pass their driver’s test! Dr. Phil sits down with the entire family one last time. Will they use the tools he gave them to build healthier relationships?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Recently, parents across America were googling “Who is Andrew Tate?” making him number three in Google searches for 2022, right behind Queen Elizabeth and Donald Trump. Tate claims to be helping young men acquire lots of money, drive luxury cars, and pick up hot women. However, in August 2022, Tate was banned on social media for his misogynist viewpoints. Twenty-four-year-old Ben says when he was a teen, he had zero self-esteem, never got past the first date, and felt powerless with girls. He tells Dr. Phil that men like Tate inspired him to break out of his shell -- and he shares how. Then, a healthy debate about “toxic masculinity” with the “Godfather of the Manosphere," a scholar and author, a men’s rights attorney, and the CEO and founder of the Center for Countering Digital Hate.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Andrew Tate is known for his misogynistic social media posts and videos claiming to be helping young men acquire lots of money, drive luxury cars, and pick up hot women. Tate is fighting a legal battle in Romania right now, but should parents worry about his influence on their sons? Before Tate was detained, Dr. Phil spoke with Richard Reeves, senior fellow at the Brookings Institute and author “Of Boys and Men: Why the Modern Male is Struggling, Why it Matters, and What to Do about It”; Marilyn York, a men’s rights attorney; Imran Ahmed, CEO and founder of the Center for Countering Digital Hate; and blogger and author Rollo Tomassi. Plus, hear from a group of teenage boys who surprise their mothers when they share what they think about Tate. And, Robin joins the conversation.

In one altercation, Levi says Tiffani spit in her face, punched her and threatened to push her off a balcony, and now she’s afraid for her life. Bob says Tiffani doesn’t respect discipline or any authority -- including the police. Tiffani has been in juvenile detention three times, and Bob says each time she's released, her behavior only escalates. Dr. Phil takes a look into their family dynamics. Watch while Morgan reveals details of a 25-minute phone conversation he had with Donald Trump -- their first communication in months after he unfollowed Morgan on Twitter earlier this year. Dr. Phil and Morgan take a look at some of the most shocking stories of celebrities who have been "cancelled" in 2020, as well as some of the most tone-deaf mistakes made by the rich and famous. Also, how does Morgan keep his emotional and mental health in check during these trying times? Tune in to find out!

programme.desc: Dr. Phil investigates what he believes is a problematic phenomenon in our society: Cancel Culture: the way a large group of people can turn on and seek to dismantle the character, career, and sometimes life, of a person who says or does something that doesn't align with the group world view. Dr. Phil welcomes DailyMail.com editor-at-large Piers Morgan, whose new book Wake Up examines this very topic. Dr. Phil also invites Antifa member Daryle, and housewife turned activist Gina, who believes cancel culture is sometimes the only way to bring bigoted people to justice. Watch while Dr. Phil weighs in on this fierce debate!

Are athletes being coached to believe they are individually more important than their teams and that the rules simply don’t apply to them? Dr. Phil sits down with parents, athletes, coaches, and students who all say yes – but they strongly disagree about who is to blame. A coach claims parents are to blame due to modeling outrageous and entitled behavior. However, the sports parents in Dr. Phil’s audience push back, claiming coaches need to stop blaming them and start blaming themselves. Then, meet a referee who wrote an emotional email to parents informing them he was quitting due to their sideline behavior. And, a former all-American quarterback talks about the dark side of college sports. Plus, ESPN investigative reporter Paula Lavigne reveals some of what she has uncovered.

Then, Teresa says she knows firsthand the double standard when it comes to athletic preferential treatment because, even though the person who assaulted her was convicted, served time, and had to register as a sex offender, he was allowed to return to the field and was hailed as a star for another university. Matt says he and three friends were drinking at a party nearly nine months ago when the four boys had sex with a 16-year-old classmate. He claims she initiated the encounter and that the sex was consensual. Matt and the three boys are charged with second-degree rape, and Matt says his dreams of getting a college scholarship have been put on hold. How does he describe the events of that night? And, what, if anything, does he say he’d do differently? Then, hear from the alleged victim, who is speaking out for the first time. What does she recall happening that night? And, how has the ordeal impacted her life? Plus, Matt’s parents, Dianne and Mark, insist their son is innocent and say they believe the alleged victim is out for attention. programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil delves into the dangers of teenage sex and underage drinking -- and how three families have been affected. Why does she say her peers care more about the accused football players than they do her? Don’t miss Matt and his parents’ reactions to what she has to say. Then, Leah alleges that in 2011, her 15-year-old daughter, Rehtaeh, was raped by four classmates at a party, and that after nearly a year-and-a-half of relentless bullying, the teen took her own life. How could this have been prevented? And what message does Leah have for others in similar situations? Plus, hear from Alexis, who says she too was raped at 15 and “could’ve been Rehtaeh.” What does she say got her through her darkest moments? Don’t miss this powerful cautionary tale for every teen and parent! This program contains strong sexual content.

programme.desc: The Surgeon General’s Advisory stated, before the COVID-19 pandemic, mental health challenges were the leading cause of disability and poor life outcomes in young people. The pandemic shutdown further exacerbated the mental challenges, and youth mental health is trending in the wrong direction across the country. Why is this happening? How do parents and schools play a role? Some experts believe young people were never taught how to fend for themselves because they were raised in a bubble by “concierge parents“ who protected them from learning about life and developing resiliency. Twenty-four-year-old Gracelyn says she describes her childhood just that way. She admits she was overprotected in some ways growing up, which she believes led to struggles with anxiety and depression for the past six years. What does she reveal for the first time? Also, parents of teens with mental health struggles talk about their frustrations. This is a life-saving episode you won’t want to miss.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The conversation about the rise in mental health issues among young people continues. Dr. Phil speaks with 22-year-old Emma, who says she was a cheerleader and “picture-perfect American girl” who appeared happy on the outside but was secretly struggling with severe anxiety and depression, which led her to make a near-fatal decision that changed her life forever. Ross Szabo, the wellness director at Geffen Academy at UCLA, the CEO of the Human Power Project, and co-author with Melanie Hall of Behind Happy Faces: Taking Charge of Your Mental Health, says he has ideas to implement more mental health education in schools. And, Massachusetts's Congressman Seth Moulton shares his latest project: the new 9-8-8 National Suicide Prevention Lifeline. Americans experiencing a mental health crisis or who are concerned about the mental health of a loved one are now able to dial 9-8-8 and get rapid, free, trained and confidential help from a network of 200+ local crisis centers nationwide.

programme.title: Paranormal Destinations
programme.desc: This documentary explores paranormal occurrences on the island of Newfoundland, the most haunted place in Canada. Some of these ghosts are said to be mischievous and they truly enjoy letting people know they are around. The stories are told by the people who have experienced these paranormal occurrences. We look at the quirky, mischievous, fun, and sometimes funny ghosts, the coincidences, the unbelievable and, the unexplained-what we call a Paradox.

programme.title: Murder on the Pole
programme.desc: One night Bunny was the queen of the dance floor; the next, she was a chalk outline. Dismissed by a department eager to sweep a "club girl's" death under the rug, Lola refuses to let her sister’s killer walk free. To find the murderer, Lola must infiltrate the world that claimed Bunny’s life—a world of predatory regulars, backstage betrayals, and a cover-up that goes higher than she ever imagined.

programme.title: Cougar
programme.desc: Donna and her young college son Brandon live in a nice suburban area of Atlanta, until a new and mysterious older woman moves in next door. Donna invites her over to dinner where she and Brandon connect, and build a connection that is deadly and manipulative. A mother must save her son before it’s too late.

programme.title: The Betrayal 5: Kutthroat Fa Eva
programme.desc: Love, power, and revenge fuel the war between two rival gangs. As blood spills and alliances crumble, a forbidden romance continues to spark in the chaos. But the streets are buzzing with questions about the updates with TK! Is it all part of the plan, or the beginning of the end?

programme.title: Money Gang Lit
programme.desc: Hakeem Benson, a down-on-his-luck videographer, is evicted and adrift. He takes a risky music video gig for Bull Dawg, a notorious kingpin. But when a respected gang member is murdered, Hakeem is falsely accused and targeted. Now, in a city on fire, he's fighting for his life and meaning amidst the chaos.

programme.title: Who is She
programme.desc: Megan is a beautiful woman in search of love and acceptance but masks a tormented soul. Beneath the surface lies a volatile woman with multiple personalities and a dangerous capacity for violence.

programme.title: Something Old
programme.desc: With her wedding days away, Kara agrees to meet her ex, Malik, for what she swears is just one last goodbye. But Malik isn’t looking for closure—he wants her back, and he’s not taking no for an answer. What starts as a simple meetup at a hotel turns into a dangerous game of obsession and control. As Kara’s fiancé Jordan uncovers the truth with help from her maid of honor, time’s running out.

programme.title: Scandalous
programme.desc: Lady Watts, a bestselling author, reveals secrets about her affairs with those closest to her in her latest memoir. At her launch party, a heated argument turns violent, and she's left unconscious. As detectives investigate, secrets, love triangles, and betrayal emerge. The search for the attacker leads to twists and turns, involving everyone from her talent manager to her labelmate. The truth about the night of the attack is slowly revealed, with unexpected consequences for all involved.

programme.title: CODE
programme.desc: Dallas artist MALIK SCHAEFER, also known as CODE, is a rising star in the underground rap scene. Although his checkered past has led him down the wrong road at times, with the help of his best friend, STYLES, Malik is back on the fast-track to success. That is, until he reconnects with the dangerous love of his life, SOPHIA ORTEGA, who threatens to destroy it all. Malik must decide to either follow his heart or live by the code that has served him well for many years: family over everything.

programme.title: Trap A Fool
programme.desc: After two years of what he thought was a perfect relationship, Jeremiah uncovers his beloved Shay-Shay's "black book" of men. He is forced to realize that her gentle nature was a facade, a calculated move in her "game of fools." Shay-Shay's only loves are herself, sex, and money, and their dangerous game is about to end.

programme.title: Gigalow
programme.desc: Diamond White, a college graduate drowning in debt and raising his younger sister, turns to dancing for survival. After moving to Texas, he joins Midnight, an underground male club, and quickly rises to the top. But as money and temptation pull him deeper, Diamond must choose between responsibility and a lifestyle that could cost him everything.

programme.title: Crash Out
programme.desc: An up-and-coming podcast starts to take off, they land an exclusive interview with a controversial wellness guru. But when an on-air confrontation begins to escalate, the effects of his own product begin to take over with deadly consequences.

programme.title: Deadly Surrogate
programme.desc: When a young married couple suffer the pain of infertility, they look to the path of surrogacy and come upon Alana as a potential candidate. As the three become intertwined, tensions begin to unravel and threaten to consume them.

programme.title: If I Can't Have You
programme.desc: Marc, a married man embarks on an affair with the seductive and enigmatic Marissa, that quickly turns into a nightmare. Lust quickly evolves into obsession when she realizes that Marc will never leave his wife. Marissa embarks on a deadly campaign of jealousy and deceit, leaving only destruction in her wake following the mantra "If I can't have you, no one else can." Marc must protect his family, while also confronting the darkest corners of his past that will define the course of his life.

programme.title: Shotlanta
programme.desc: Mozzy, driven by a desire to lift his family out of poverty in Jamaica, emigrates to Atlanta. He quickly rises in the ranks of the city's drug trade, determined to achieve wealth and security for his mother and sister. However, his ruthless pursuit of success puts him on a dangerous path, where the line between ambition and destruction blurs.

programme.title: Single Black Female
programme.desc: Rose is a young college freshman who meets her roommate Max for the first time. The two develop an intense bond, and Max is willing to prove her loyalty to Rose, even if it means someone will have to die if they get in the way.

programme.title: Aliens in the Hood
programme.desc: The hood politics of the neighborhood become even more complicated after the arrival of aliens! When one man in the neighborhood is blessed with superpowers, he and the other warring factions are headed to war over control of the current drug trade.

programme.title: Toxic King
programme.desc: Keeng is searching for love in all the wrong places. After years of trouble relationships, he decides to just be a playboy and become a “serial love hopper” that is until he reunites with Zuri, a college friend who he has always had a crush on. Will he fight for true love? Or resign to being a Toxic King?

programme.title: Love and Deceit 2
programme.desc: Carolyn, a successful businesswoman moves to a new town in hopes of laying down some roots after her divorce. She joins a local women’s group ran by Beverly Jordan a respected therapist to help process her emotions. When in reality, she’s there to rekindle an old flame with a former lover, who happens to be Beverly’s husband.

programme.title: Art of Murder
programme.desc: Detectives Trent Rollins and Latoya Cooper investigate a series of murders in which the victims all bear a mysterious symbol that’s connected to a previous murder of a known artist, Preston Sacher. As they close in, Rollins finds himself stuck between protecting his family, and doing what’s right.

programme.title: The Agony and the Ecstasy
programme.desc: When rival gangster Derrick Smith is released from prison, the beef with Armand Rossi explodes into an all-out war in Fountain City, MO. After a hit on his family , Armand goes into killer mode. Derrick and Vic Moore team up for revenge , but Rossi and his partner Qua stay ahead. When they involve Dr. Monica Gaye in the plot , she flips the script to survive. A devastating loss sends a grieving Armand past the point of no return , forcing him to eliminate every one of his opps.

programme.title: Commandments of a Female Hustler
programme.desc: Three childhood friends, Lala, Binky, and Jay grew up together on the streets of East Baltimore. Wanting a better life for themselves, they learn the ways of hustling. When they align themselves with one of the most powerful drug dealers in the game, their loyalties are tested, and the very commandments that once bound them start to break.

programme.title: Camera Girl
programme.desc: After witnessing Atlanta’s underground rap scene firsthand, a quiet but driven young woman buys her first camera and sets out to become a music videographer. But as she fights for recognition, she’s pulled into a harsh world where talent is exploited and credit is stolen. Forced to choose between giving up or betting on herself, she risks everything to turn her passion into a career.

programme.title: The Offer
programme.desc: When Devin and Imani—an estranged couple drowning under financial pressure—receive an unmarked briefcase containing a life-changing sum of money, they find themselves faced with an impossible decision. As tensions rise, secrets unravel, and old wounds reopen, the couple begins to fracture under the moral and emotional weight of the offer.

programme.title: Blood in the Comments
programme.desc: Azariyah, a rising content creator and self-proclaimed relationship expert has routine live event online discussing relationships and creating content. When Danica reaches out to her about her boyfriend’s sexuality, Azariyah suggests she confronts him, which leads to Danica taking her own life. Haunted by the guilt, Azariyah searches for the truth amidst a wave of threats and online violence.

programme.title: The Shining Star of Lawrence Hilton-Jacobs
programme.desc: The story of the life and career of one of America’s favorite actors, Lawrence-Hilton Jacobs (Welcome Back Kotter, The Jacksons: An American Dream, Claudine, Cooley High). In fascinating form, Mr. Hilton Jacobs takes us on his life’s journey from his childhood beginning in Harlem, New York to the bright lights of the Broadway Stage and on to becoming a Hollywood movie and television star.

programme.title: Receipts
programme.desc: Meeko, a high-level drug dealer, has built a thriving operation and a reputation to match. But when his supplier is suddenly killed and his entire network collapses, his supply chain runs dry with no chance of recovery. As a means to pivot, he resorts to a new business venture – blackmail.

programme.title: The Other Sister
programme.desc: After ending her relationship to focus on her future, a driven young woman invites her troubled sister to move in for a fresh start. But as boundaries begin to blur, jealousy turns into obsession, and trust quickly unravels. When secrets come to light, she must confront a chilling truth. Sometimes the biggest threat isn’t a stranger. It’s family.

programme.title: Till Lies Do Us Part
programme.desc: Amina and Alex announce their engagement to their family and friends after only dating for six months, and are having a destination wedding at that. As the romantic and loving getaway goes along, betrayals and hidden truths come to the surface causing chaos and drama.

programme.title: Garrett Morris and Michael Schultz
programme.desc: The story of the careers of legendary actor Garrett Morrison and legendary movie director Michael Schultz. Follow their life and career from their early beginnings to adulthood and becoming worldwide legendary artists from Broadway to Hollywood.

programme.title: Don Dada
programme.desc: Desperate to survive a brutal Chicago winter, Rah Jah and Tee Tee hustle for food and shelter in the streets. When a botched deal lands him in the hands of powerful crime bosses, he rises to the top of the hierarchy at a deadly cost.

programme.title: Crush
programme.desc: Haunted by her past, a young woman's life is complicated by love, self-discovery, and surrounding violence.

programme.title: The Forsaken
programme.desc: After discovering an old book, Alex becomes drawn into the harrowing stories of cowboys Latt and Stylz. As he reads about their treasure hunt and daring adventures, Alex finds inspiration in their courage and friendship to use in his own life and help him find the strength to overcome his own obstacles.

programme.title: Untangled Mirror
programme.desc: J. Nicole is a determined mother, entrepreneur, and hairstylist fighting to balance her personal and professional worlds while navigating love, family, and the weight of false perceptions. By day, she runs her salon with pride, presenting herself as confident and successful. But behind closed doors, she faces child custody battles, tense encounters with her ex, and a controlling new partner.

programme.title: Cooperating Criminals
programme.desc: Tony's ambition ignites a powder keg of betrayal. Driven by Bianca's manipulation, he pushes his pill operation, ignoring Jay's warnings. As DEA Agent Harrison closes in, Jay battles his past to protect Tony. A dangerous deal with Marco, escalates the chaos, leading to overdose and murder plots. Now, Tony faces a stark choice: witness or prison.

programme.title: Thick Trip
programme.desc: Four close-knit friends, all single and yearning for a change, embark on a summer-long 'Queen's Trip' to South Padre, Houston, and the untouched wilderness. As they travel and experience the vibrant cultures and breathtaking landscapes, they confront their fears, rediscover their passions, and explore their own wild sides.

programme.title: He Killed My Sister
programme.desc: When Malorie's sister, Monica, disappears, everyone around her tells her to grieve and move on. Determined to bring her justice, Malorie embarks on a search for the truth. But when she meets Tyriq, his motives may not be as pure as they seem.

programme.title: Deliveries From Eva
programme.desc: Disgraced music star Reese is surprised to learn that he still has a fan in the form of delivery driver, Eva. The two form an unlikely friendship that begins to sour due to Eva's growing obsession and her struggles with PTSD.

programme.title: It's Complicated AF
programme.desc: After an intense romance, Ryan and Quaves make the crazy decision to get married without having met in person. But as friends and family gather in Houston for a whirlwind wedding weekend, everything spirals into chaos as the bridal party clashes over secret agendas, bruised egos, and a stolen parking spot. A romantic comedy about fate, bad timing, and the kind of love that refuses to show up quietly.

programme.title: Deadly Surrogate
programme.desc: When a young married couple suffer the pain of infertility, they look to the path of surrogacy and come upon Alana as a potential candidate. As the three become intertwined, tensions begin to unravel and threaten to consume them.

programme.title: Crash Out
programme.desc: An up-and-coming podcast starts to take off, they land an exclusive interview with a controversial wellness guru. But when an on-air confrontation begins to escalate, the effects of his own product begin to take over with deadly consequences.

programme.title: Kill For You
programme.desc: Suga, a devoted mother, finds herself opening up to love again when she begins a relationship with Danny, a man who seems genuine and caring. But their connection is quickly tested when she is introduced to Danny’s father, Rusty—a man whose deeply rooted racism creates an undercurrent of tension that can’t be ignored. As Suga tries to navigate the relationship while protecting her son, she begins to sense that something isn’t right beneath the surface.

programme.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA)
programme.desc: The atmosphere at the Arch Pickleball Center is electric as the Wisconsin Badgers face off against the UCSD Tritons on Championship Sunday. The match features a high-speed Racing intensity as both teams fight to stay alive in the single-elimination bracket. Fans will see the refined Skills of Kina Chang and the tactical precision of Lisa Ritchie as they trade "laser beam" drives and calculated dinks at the kitchen line. With Freestyle shot-making on full display—from around-the-post (ATP) winners to highlight-reel volleys—this quarterfinal clash proves that the best collegiate pickleball in the nation was truly saved for Sunday.

programme.desc: Experience the high-stakes intensity of a "Battle for the Bid" at the 2024 DUPR Florida Super Regional in Port Saint Lucie. This match pits the seasoned Kennesaw State Owls against a surprising Georgia Tech squad that is brand new to the tournament scene. Despite Kennesaw entering as the heavy 80% statistical favorite, the Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets delivered a stunning wake-up call with a dominant 21–9 victory in Women's Doubles. Now, the Owls must lean on their powerhouse Men’s and Mixed Doubles teams to claw back and keep their championship dreams alive. With a direct invitation to the Collegiate Pickleball Nationals in Dallas on the line, every point is a fight for survival in this premier regional showcase.

programme.title: Car History

programme.title: Supercars

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: In 2014, Mercedes-Benz presented their first Plug-in Hybrid, the S500. When it comes to Bentley, a V8 engine means down-sizing. We took a look at the brand's Flying Spur model with a smaller engine. And: the 6th generation Maserati Quattroporte.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Benjamín revela que Carero intentó matarlo. Celia sufre una hemorragia y es trasladada de urgencia para una cesárea; Katiuska realiza rituales oscuros deseando su muerte. Marcelo y María del Pilar se reconcilian tras una fuerte discusión por Gustavo. Ricardo acude a la clínica desesperado por la salud de Celia, mientras Manuela se niega a revelarle la verdad. Alejandro decide enfrentar sus problemas en lugar de huir.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Agustín trae a Rodrigo de regreso a casa. Magdalena está muy agradecida, aunque en el fondo ella ya no siente lo mismo por Agustín y ha comenzado a pensar en Gabriel. Él también piensa en ella a pesar de haberse reconciliado con Angie. A pesar de que Gabriel le cuenta a Nayarí que él es el padre de Deibis, ella se niega a que Gabriel entre en la vida del chico. Gabriel sólo buscar ayudar de cualquier manera, tratando de remendar su pasado irresponsable, según él. A fin de cuentas, Nayarí va a visitarlo para hablar con él. - Al enterarse que a Deibis le robaron la camioneta, Toño se enfurece, así que el chico decide ir a buscarla para recuperarla. Julieta encuentra una foto de Valentina junto a sus padres.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Magdalena está de acuerdo con Gabriel en que entre ellos dos algo pasa. Sin embargo como ambos tienen familias y vidas ya armadas, ella piensa que todo eso debe terminar. Mientras hablan, un paparazzi los ve y los fotografía. Luego, este le lleva las fotos a Ricardo un miembro de “La Deslenguada”. Estas podrían servir para comprobar una posible infidelidad por parte de los dos hacia sus respectivas parejas. Julieta continúa tratando de localizar a Gabriel para poder averiguar más sobre él y su vida. Es entonces cuando conoce a Valentina, la mujer que vio en la foto junto con sus padres, pero que no sabe la relación cercana que hay entre ellas. Los padres de Julieta no están de acuerdo con la vocación que eligió y por más de que tratan de que ella cambie de opinión no logran hacerlo.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Sofía le entrega a Magdalena la información acerca del verdadero padre de su hijo, aunque ésta decide no abrir el sobre para no seguir arruinando su vida. Agustín minimiza los hechos, diciendo que el pasado forma parte del pasado. Gabriel envía a Epicúreo al barrio donde vive Nayarí, para que busque a Deibis y vea cómo él vive. Epi no lo distingue porque se encuentra junto a otros chicos y no lo puede distinguir. Luego de una persecución de Antonio, logra salir del barrio sin que le pase nada. Julieta conoce a Valentina en la oficina. Tanto Efraín como Ana Belén se preocupan por esto y llenan a su hija de preguntas, aunque en realidad no pasó lo que a ellos le da miedo.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Gabriel le recrimina a Nayarí la forma de llegar al estudio. Ella le hace comprender que lo mismo le pasó con él en el barrio. Y finalmente llegan a un acuerdo, y Gabriel acepta decirle a Deibis que es su tío, en lugar de su padre. Todos están muy intrigados por la llegada de Nayarí, pero sobre todo Angie. Epi le cuenta a Gloria que Valentina cree que él es gay. Efraín se encuentra a almorzar con Valentina. Y ella se va muy acongojada al escuchar las palabras de Efraín diciendo, que es una extraña en la vida de Julieta. Ricardo va a la casa de Julieta a buscar un supuesto CD. Julieta le presenta a su mamá, Ana Belén. Ricardo le confiesa que fue por ella, y que quiere que se encuentren a solas en algún lugar.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Toño desconfía de Nayarí, piensa que tiene algo con Gabriel León pero ella niega todo y termina contándole que Deibis es sobrino de Gabriel, o sea, este y el capitán hermanos. Gabriel le jura a Magdalena que él no tiene nada que ver con las fotos que le llegaron y si no fue un Paparazi desconfían de ambos esposos. Luego ella se siente muy culpable y deja bien en claro que no son amantes, es ahí cuando se larga a llover y León le dice que no ha dejado de pensar en ella. Mientras tanto Marilyn y Angie miran las mismas fotos y esta última se enoja mucho porque ve a su marido con otra mujer. Julieta habla con Valentina para que la ayude a hacer un reportaje a Gabriel León y esta acepta.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Sol le confiesa a Alejandro que cree que Heriberto abusó de ella. Esto enfurece a Alejandro que sale junto a ella para vengarse de Heriberto antes que se lo lleven en avión hacia Texas. Cuando llegan todo sale mal y Heriberto termina secuestrando a Sol y llevándosela en un auto. Heriberto la lleva al hospital y secuestra a la doctora que le hizo el examen a Sol para que le confiese la verdad. Así es como Sol se entera que Reina amenazó a su doctora para decirle que Heriberto abusó de ella.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Ana y Guillermo se conocen casualmente y se enamoran a primera vista, pero luego de una breve charla cada uno continúa su camino sin darse cuenta que no se han intercambiado teléfonos, excepto sus nombres. Este amor permanece en ellos durante tres años, se buscan mutuamente, pero sin ningún resultado positivo. La quiebra de los bancos europeos deja en bancarrota a los Ibáñez, quienes a partir de ahora deberán acostumbrarse a vivir en un ambiente menos lujoso. Y deben bajar su nivel de vida. Carlos Enrique se siente un inútil porque lleva más de 3 años sin trabajar. Tres años más tarde el destino vuelve a reunir a Guillermo y Ana, pero cada uno ya tiene su propia historia

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Las familias recién llegadas se van acomodando en sus nuevos hogares en el condómino. Ana y Guillermo se enteran que serán vecinos, noticia para la que ninguno estaba preparado. Ana descubre que su amor está casado y tiene una hija. Por la otra parte Guillermo descubre que la novia de su primo es su Ana que estuvo buscando por tres años. Ambos no pueden creer lo que les está pasando. El fantasma observa todas las casas del condominio a través de cámaras que él ha instalado en su Penthouse, tiene en vista a Conrado para su próxima estafa. Carlos Enrique, que ha estado casi mudo a causa de la depresión que le ha provocado la quiebra del banco donde tenía todos sus ahorros

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Luego de que se encontraran Ana y Guillermo, cada uno con una vida muy distinta a la que hubieran imaginado, pero sintiendo lo mismo que sintieron aquella primera vez que se vieron, quedaron con muchas preguntas por hacerse. Eso lleva a Guillermo a contactar a Ana mediante un mensaje, que luego se transformó en una visita hacia la casa de ella. Ya uno, enfrente del otro comenzaron a preguntarse sobre sus respectivas parejas. Pero llegan a un punto donde deciden arriesgarse del todo. El primer impulso es dejarlo todo y comenzar de nuevo, pero empiezan a surgir los inconvenientes, uno de ellos, Guillermo tiene una hija a la cual deberá sacrificar el verla sólo los fines de semana.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Cuando Guillermo y Ana decidieron no dejar a sus respectivas parejas, no luchar por su amor, no tenían idea de que les iba a resultar imposible. Así es como Ana levantada le pide a su madre un poco más de café, por desvelarse toda la noche pensando en Guillermo. Le cuenta a su madre, y ésta sólo le dice que tiene que olvidarse de Guillermo y seguir adelante con Cristóbal. A pesar de lo mal que se siente Ana, toma la decisión definitiva de olvidar a Guillermo, y ser feliz con Cristóbal. Éste por su parte pasa a buscar a Ana para llevarla al trabajo y regalarle flores. Ana le plantea la posibilidad de casarse cuanto antes. Cristóbal toma muy a gusto el planteo Ana, ya que la sentía dubitativa con respecto al casamiento.

programme.title: Episodio 101
programme.desc: Yubiri histérica y furiosa le como le comunica a los presentes que ha decidido renunciar | que se va de la Agencia. Briggite se muestra preocupada con la noticia mientras que cada uno se retrae en sus pensamientos. Yubiri le grita a Briggite una vez más su decisión de irse de la agencia. Entre tanto Wilker y su grupo de música ACAN de terminar la grabación de su disco; con un gran éxito; Los muchachos ríen y se disponen a celebrar | mientras Wilker internamente se regocija pensando en Yuribi.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Ana le dice a Pastor que no la bese ya que él es gay. Pastor le dice que no lo es | y que para conseguir el puesto con Mauricio tuvo que hacerse pasar por gay porque sino Mauricio no lo empleaba. En la casa de Gisela está Mauricio ya que son amigos de mucho tiempo. Ella trata de averiguar si es gay. El no cae en la trampa y llega Atanasio. Pastor ve la imagen de Olegario y el le dice a Ana que lo disculpe que no volverá a pasar aunque en verdad está enamorado de ella. A Ana le gustó Juan Diego.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Wilker va a la casa de Yubiri para llevarle el CD. Cuando llega Yubiri está totalmente fuera de sí por lo de Briggite y le forma tremendo escándalo botándolo de la casa. El le deja el CD. Daniel Alvarado llega a la oficina de Junior. Graciela está que se muere y Daniel Alvarado le dice a Junior que el guión necesita unos ajustes. Esto no le gusta para nada a Junior. Wilker está sumamente triste caminando por el centro comercial y Solymar lo ve y lo va a saludar. El le regala un CD.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Fabián le cuenta a Armando un poco de cosas echándoselas de machista. Pero le dice que ya está de nuevo viviendo con Finita. Finita le sigue contando a su amiga Rossy que mientras no se enteren ni Fabián ni Armando | ella es feliz. Mauricio está de nuevo contándole a Pastor que él tiene que fingir ante la gente pero en ese momento llega Atanasio. Pastor respira profundo. Ana le recrimina a Olegario que no la haya felicitado por su aumento.

programme.title: Episodio 105
programme.desc: Fabián y Armando llegan a la casa de Finita los dos totalmente borrachos. Finita ni habla | solamente llora. Armando le llama señora Nevera. Ana sigue quejándose con Mauricio de la actitud de Olegario. Mauricio le da una charla del hombre machista latinoamericano. Olegario y Pastor están tomándose unos tragos y hablando de Ana. Ana le pide a Mauricio que se quede más tiempo con ella pero le dice que su mamá está enferma y que tiene mucho trabajo.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Agustín trae a Rodrigo de regreso a casa. Magdalena está muy agradecida, aunque en el fondo ella ya no siente lo mismo por Agustín y ha comenzado a pensar en Gabriel. Él también piensa en ella a pesar de haberse reconciliado con Angie. A pesar de que Gabriel le cuenta a Nayarí que él es el padre de Deibis, ella se niega a que Gabriel entre en la vida del chico. Gabriel sólo buscar ayudar de cualquier manera, tratando de remendar su pasado irresponsable, según él. A fin de cuentas, Nayarí va a visitarlo para hablar con él. - Al enterarse que a Deibis le robaron la camioneta, Toño se enfurece, así que el chico decide ir a buscarla para recuperarla. Julieta encuentra una foto de Valentina junto a sus padres.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Magdalena está de acuerdo con Gabriel en que entre ellos dos algo pasa. Sin embargo como ambos tienen familias y vidas ya armadas, ella piensa que todo eso debe terminar. Mientras hablan, un paparazzi los ve y los fotografía. Luego, este le lleva las fotos a Ricardo un miembro de “La Deslenguada”. Estas podrían servir para comprobar una posible infidelidad por parte de los dos hacia sus respectivas parejas. Julieta continúa tratando de localizar a Gabriel para poder averiguar más sobre él y su vida. Es entonces cuando conoce a Valentina, la mujer que vio en la foto junto con sus padres, pero que no sabe la relación cercana que hay entre ellas. Los padres de Julieta no están de acuerdo con la vocación que eligió y por más de que tratan de que ella cambie de opinión no logran hacerlo.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Sofía le entrega a Magdalena la información acerca del verdadero padre de su hijo, aunque ésta decide no abrir el sobre para no seguir arruinando su vida. Agustín minimiza los hechos, diciendo que el pasado forma parte del pasado. Gabriel envía a Epicúreo al barrio donde vive Nayarí, para que busque a Deibis y vea cómo él vive. Epi no lo distingue porque se encuentra junto a otros chicos y no lo puede distinguir. Luego de una persecución de Antonio, logra salir del barrio sin que le pase nada. Julieta conoce a Valentina en la oficina. Tanto Efraín como Ana Belén se preocupan por esto y llenan a su hija de preguntas, aunque en realidad no pasó lo que a ellos le da miedo.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Gabriel le recrimina a Nayarí la forma de llegar al estudio. Ella le hace comprender que lo mismo le pasó con él en el barrio. Y finalmente llegan a un acuerdo, y Gabriel acepta decirle a Deibis que es su tío, en lugar de su padre. Todos están muy intrigados por la llegada de Nayarí, pero sobre todo Angie. Epi le cuenta a Gloria que Valentina cree que él es gay. Efraín se encuentra a almorzar con Valentina. Y ella se va muy acongojada al escuchar las palabras de Efraín diciendo, que es una extraña en la vida de Julieta. Ricardo va a la casa de Julieta a buscar un supuesto CD. Julieta le presenta a su mamá, Ana Belén. Ricardo le confiesa que fue por ella, y que quiere que se encuentren a solas en algún lugar.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Toño desconfía de Nayarí, piensa que tiene algo con Gabriel León pero ella niega todo y termina contándole que Deibis es sobrino de Gabriel, o sea, este y el capitán hermanos. Gabriel le jura a Magdalena que él no tiene nada que ver con las fotos que le llegaron y si no fue un Paparazi desconfían de ambos esposos. Luego ella se siente muy culpable y deja bien en claro que no son amantes, es ahí cuando se larga a llover y León le dice que no ha dejado de pensar en ella. Mientras tanto Marilyn y Angie miran las mismas fotos y esta última se enoja mucho porque ve a su marido con otra mujer. Julieta habla con Valentina para que la ayude a hacer un reportaje a Gabriel León y esta acepta.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leonardo le revela a Rebeca que Mateo es hijo suyo. Se lo dirán a los demás después de la renovación del acta. Trinidad y Virginia se enteran de que María Lucía está con Leo. Cuando ella llega a la casa, les confiesa que ama a Leo. Rodrigo idea un plan de escape para huir al Caribe con Alejandray evitar la muerte de ambos. Ella duda, porque no quiere renunciar a su vida, pero Rodrigo la convence. Quedan en encontrarse en un estacionamiento para escapar. Felipe le sugiere a Irene casarse, para complicarle a Leonardo la paternidad de Mateo. Irene se niega a casarse por compromiso. Ahora cree que Leonardo se merece el derecho a ser padre de Mateo.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Alejandra se arrepiente de huir con Rodrigo. Adolfo visita los laboratorios y le recuerda a Rodrigo que investigue lo del juicio y a Alejandra, que tienen un compromiso más tarde. Alejandra empieza a contarle a Carlos Ernesto que está en problemas, Rodrigo la interrumpe y se la lleva de su oficina, donde forcejean y Toni lo ve por la cámara. Irene le confiesa a Virginia que tiene reservas sobre la paternidad de Leonardo por miedo a que Rebeca maltrate a Mateo. Virginia le aconseja llegar a una negociación y evitar los problemas legales. Leonardo le revela a Maribel que está dispuesto a dejarlo todo por recuperar a Irene. Trinidad se entera que Leo y María Lucía quieren fugarse a Francia y que lo planean desde hace tiempo.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Rebeca le explica a Keka que ella se sentía triste y el Edgar le dio un abrazo de amigos. Keka le comenta que sus hermanos se fueron a ver a Mateo. Lucas y Miguel van a la casa de Trinidad a ver a Mateo, Rebeca los encuentra, los regaña y le anuncia a Trinidad que ellas nunca conseguirán que Leonardo reconozca a Mateo. Cuando llegan a la casa, Keka le cuenta lo del doctor a su abuela. Leo habla con su padre. Le expresa que quiere hacer las cosas bien con María Lucía, y no hacerla sufrir como él hizo con Irene, y le pide que vaya a decirles a Trinidad y Virginia que él es un buen hombre y no piensa abandonarla. Leo, por otra parte, le aconseja a su padre hablarle con el corazón a Irene.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Jimena le cuenta a Leonardo que Keka vio a Rebeca y su doctor abrazándose y le pide que cancelara la ceremonia de renovación de votos. Leonardo no le cree pero se queda pensando al respecto de eso, por lo que, decide ir a preguntarle directamente a Rebeca lo ocurrido. Rebeca inmediatamente desmiente toda situación comprometedora con su doctor y se justifica diciendo que le rompe el corazón que piense que ella lo podría estar engañando. Adolfo amenaza a Rodrigo, debe encontrarla a Alejandra lo antes posible porque si no va a quedar gravemente inculpado en los actos de su novia. Adolfo no confía más en él.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Felipe puso en marcha el proceso de denuncia sobre la declaración de Alejandra, y junto a Carlos Ernesto intentan detener a Adolfo y a Rebeca antes de que sea demasiado tarde. Leo y María Lucía están dispuestos a luchar por su unión, hablan con Virginia y Trinidad y enfrentan a Julio después de enterarse de una mentira que le contó a Trinidad. Leonardo nuevamente intenta, en su última oportunidad antes de casarse, de demostrarle su amor a Irene para que ella lo acepte y así detener la boda. La policía detiene a Rodrigo e intenta llevarlo a la comisaría. En ese momento, la gente de Adolfo comienza a disparar para matar a Rodrigo y le dan un disparo. Tony compró un anillo de compromiso y se le declarará a Maribel.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Benjamín es encarcelado y liberado tras meses por Hortensia, quien ignora que Julio César ordenó matarlo. Celia descubre que tiene una enfermedad terminal y lo oculta, aceptando que Ricardo dé su apellido al bebé. Katiuska quema una carta clave y busca dañar al hijo de Celia con brujería. Marcelo solicita el divorcio a Graciela y Misael prepara una prueba de ADN para Glorita, mientras se revela la verdadera naturaleza de Katiuska.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Misael le pide matrimonio a Manuela tras probar su paternidad, mientras Ovidio hace lo mismo con Celia, quien enferma gravemente. Katiuska realiza un ritual de magia negra contra Celia y se compromete con Ricardo. Alejandro se prepara para cumplir la promesa de matar a Néstor. Hortensia descubre que Celia es la madre del hijo de Benjamín y se opone a que lleve su apellido. Finalmente, Celia, Manuela y Elizabeth juran mantener en secreto la inminente muerte de Celia.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia, gravemente enferma, busca el perdón de su hermana. Mientras tanto, Gustavo inaugura su piano bar, evento al que asiste María del Pilar a escondidas. Manuela y Celia descubren con impacto la fiesta de compromiso de Ricardo y Katiuska, lo que desata la furia de Celia. En medio de celebraciones con antifaces y romances nacientes entre Margot y Alejandro, la tragedia golpea cuando Carrero apuñala a Benjamín en su celda y Katiuska recurre a la brujería para retener a Ricardo.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia y Manuela interrumpen el compromiso de Ricardo y Katiuska, lo que termina en agresiones. Benjamín es herido en la cárcel por orden de Katiuska. Celia decide ocultar su enfermedad terminal a Ricardo, mientras que Elizabeth, al enterarse del nuevo compromiso de su padre, lo rechaza definitivamente. Alejandro revela que Néstor quedará libre, y Misael, ebrio, acosa a Manuela. Finalmente, Celia echa a Ricardo de su casa tras quitarle las llaves.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Benjamín revela que Carero intentó matarlo. Celia sufre una hemorragia y es trasladada de urgencia para una cesárea; Katiuska realiza rituales oscuros deseando su muerte. Marcelo y María del Pilar se reconcilian tras una fuerte discusión por Gustavo. Ricardo acude a la clínica desesperado por la salud de Celia, mientras Manuela se niega a revelarle la verdad. Alejandro decide enfrentar sus problemas en lugar de huir.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Rene examina a Carmen Rosa y la hospitalizan una semana. Leticia insiste en que Vilma intentó matarla. Consuelo le oculta a Natalia que Erasto la visitó. Marisela y Andreína preparan maletas para Estados Unidos. Chencha llega a la residencia atormentada por su secreto. Erasto compra una quinta a nombre de Natalia mediante Rivera. Eustoquio enfrenta a Erasto amenazándolo de muerte. René revela accidentalmente a Consuelo que Arminda, la tía de Rosa, es la mujer que tenía secuestrada a Natalia. Consuelo grita como loca y cae desmayada al unir los cabos.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Consuelo se encierra en su cuarto recordando todos los maltratos que dio a Rosa sin saber que era su hija; confiesa a Leticia el descubrimiento. Junior defiende a Rosa de los insultos de Rosalía en la clínica. Alejandro confiesa a Adolfo que Rosa es su hija perdida, horrorizándolo al recordar que espera un hijo de Junior. Chencha confiesa a Blanca la verdad sobre Rosa. Erasto niega a Carmen Rosa toda culpa. Junior se desmaya al levantarse para ir al baño. Adolfo decide llamar a Consuelo para enfrentar la verdad con Rosa.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: José Luis y Natalia se reconcilian. Adolfo descubre por el médico que Junior sufrió parálisis motora y no podrá viajar. Rosa enfrenta a Consuelo en su casa y la expulsa, negándose a oírla y creéndola obsesionada con Isaías. Alejandro confiesa a Rosalía que Rosa es su hermana; ella jura odiarla siempre. Eustoquio se disfraza de Benedicto para enloquecer a Erasto. Adolfo y Marisela suspenden el viaje al exterior. Consuelo, abatida, llama a Adolfo desde el llanto para contarle que Rosa la odia a muerte y le concede toda la razón.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Erasto irrumpe en casa de Consuelo y exige llevarse a Natalia, pero ella se niega y él promete vengarse. Marisela exige a Adolfo evitar que Rosa tenga el niño. Alejandro le explica a Carmen Rosa lo del parentesco con Rosa y la convence de ayudar. Junior se compromete a casarse con Rosa pase lo que pase. Rosa decide casarse con Junior contra todos. Eustoquio sigue aterrorizando a Erasto disfrazado. Carmen Rosa duda en revelar el secreto. Consuelo decide ir a hablar con Rosa de nuevo, esta vez con calma. Isaías medita sobre la situación imposible.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Rodrigo está dispuesto a decirle a Carlos Ernesto quién asesinó a su hermano Miguel Ferrándiz a cambio de protección legal. Leonardo, que ahora sabe que es el padre de Mateo, no sabe si casarse con Rebeca es la decisión correcta. E Irene no quiere pedirle que la deje porque es él quien debe decidirlo. Tony lleva a Maribel a un restaurante de lujo para pedirle matrimonio, pero ella sufre un pequeño percance. Leo se pelea con su madre porque ella le prohíbe salir con María Lucía. Julio cuenta que Leo no es hijo de Leonardo.

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades
programme.desc: Qigong is considered one of the five branches of Chinese Medicine, a foundational basis for martial arts, and a long-standing spiritual practice revered in Daoist and Zen traditions. programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades
programme.desc: Let any burdens you carry drop away while you move through this gentle, intentional qigong practice.

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades
programme.desc: This practice begins by tending to both the Yin and Yang meridians in your body. You’ll start with a soothing self-massage, which is beneficial to the health of your vagus nerve, especially if you experience overwhelm or often feel depleted. Allow yourself to feel calm and bright as you practice the fifth and sixth Silk Brocades.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.desc: As humans, we need interconnection: We rely on others to survive, especially as children. Yet, we also strive for authenticity. This creates an inherent tension. In this lesson, Dr. Maté discusses what is true human nature — and how the modern world has warped our understanding of our needs.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.desc: Trauma is a wound that you sustain; it's not what happened to you. In this lesson, Dr. Maté explains why traumatic wounds get triggered and how to understand triggers in your process of transformation and healing.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.desc: There is a strong link between childhood trauma and health challenges. Dr. Maté demonstrates how to untangle and understand this connection with self-compassion.

programme.title: Tell My Story
programme.desc: After his son dies by suicide, a father seeks answers for what is killing today's youth.

programme.title: Piripkura
programme.desc: The last two surviving members of the Piripkura people, a nomadic tribe in the Mato Grasso region of Brazil, struggle to maintain their indigenous way of life amidst the region's massive deforestation.

programme.title: Boobs: The War On Women's Breast
programme.desc: The films investigates the controversy swirling around the breast cancer screening test mammography.

programme.title: ALCOHOL - THE MAGIC POTION
programme.desc: Alcohol is the world’s most powerful drug. Four billion people drink it regularly and the number is rising. Of the world’s 30 countries with the highest per capita alcohol consumption, no fewer than 26 are in Europe. Big business with 3 million victims each year. But who profits from all this?

programme.title: BREAD. AN EVERYDAY MIRACLE
programme.desc: Bread is a branded product with an endless number of varieties and providers. But do we actually know what we eat every day? We meet small craft bakers who stand up for their quality and we meet CEOs who work on bread as an industrial mass product which becomes increasingly artificial. How can traditional bakery skills survive? And how will the future of bread look like?

programme.title: SHARING THE HARVEST
programme.desc: SHARING THE HARVEST follows farmers who reject conventional agriculture's growth pressures. Filmmaker Philipp Petruch explores three solidarity farming initiatives aiming to build sustainable, community-supported food systems. Through community, courage, and a new consumer-producer relationship, they show how we can transform agriculture - and the world.

programme.title: JUST MOVE! ENDING THE COUCH POTATO PANDEMIC
programme.desc: Lack of physical activity is a growing problem, with over 50% of adults and 80% of young people in high-income countries being insufficiently active. The documentary JUST MOVE! ENDING THE COUCH POTATO PANDEMIC shows how we can reignite the desire for movement and overcome inactivity.

programme.title: VERY SENIOR - ATTITUDE IS EVERYTHING
programme.desc: In Sun City, the retirement community in Arizona, the residents show us how to make the best of life when death casts its shadow in old age – with attitude!

programme.title: Sex Talk

programme.title: Sex Talk
programme.desc: How often do men really think about sex? Plus, we talk about ways to maintain intimacy when you're both the caretaker and the lover.

programme.title: Sex Talk

programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.desc: Host Lisa Garr interviews Dr Jill Bolte Taylor, a Harvard-trained and published neuroanatomist. She shares with us the idea of cellular circuitry and how there are four distinct modules of cells that make up who we are, combining the thinking mind and the emotional side. She discusses her new book, Whole Brain Living: The Anatomy of Choice and the Four Characteristics that Drive Our Life.

programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.desc: Host Lisa Garr interviews Professor Robert Thurman, the preeminent scholar and interpreter of Tibetan Buddhist philosophy for the modern world, who believes that Wisdom is Bliss and in fact, that’s the name of his latest book. Thurman is a very close friend of HH Dalai Lama and today he discusses deep ideas about mindfulness and presence and leads us on a joyful exploration into the nature of reality through Buddha’s threefold curriculum.

programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.desc: Host Lisa Garr interviews Dr. Harley Rotbart, a nationally renowned infectious diseases specialist, pediatrician, parenting expert, speaker, and educator who discusses his latest book No Regrets Parenting: Turning Long Days and Short Years into Cherished Moments with Your Kids. He shares special keys for parents to guide children to live a life of wonder and contentment by conscious parenting.

programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.desc: Host Lisa Garr interviews marital and family psychologist Dr. Michael Tobin who believes the secret to a happy, long-lasting relationship is mutual respect for one another. He’s been with his life partner, soulmate, and wife, Deborah, for 47 years, and in practice as a psychologist for more than 45 years. His most recent book, Riding the Edge, A Love Song to Deborah, chronicles his six-month transformative journey.

programme.title: Rooted In Wellness
programme.desc: Why has infertility become so normal? Better yet – why are women the only one’s taking on the burden of infertility? The statistics on the amount of women struggling with PCOS (making them infertile) are only rising and with men being responsible for 50% of infertility, the conversation needs to change.

programme.title: Rooted In Wellness
programme.desc: What if the key to a vibrant, healthy life lies in returning to our ancestral roots? In this episode of Rooted in Wellness, I’m joined by Dr. Darshan Shah who works to merge ancient healing practices with modern-day science to help his patients extend both their lifespan and more importantly, their healthspan.

programme.title: Rooted In Wellness
programme.desc: Between work, family, and wellness, many women feel like they're running on empty. Mona shares empowering tools and mindset shifts to help women balance it all—without burning out. Fulfillment is possible when you root into what matters.

programme.title: Live Fearlessly with Anita Moorjani
programme.desc: In this course, Anita Moorjani guides you toward loving yourself as if your life depends on it – because it does! When love (rather than fear) determines your life, you will recognize what is truly important for you to be happy and healthy.

programme.title: Live Fearlessly with Anita Moorjani
programme.desc: Today, Anita shares what her near-death experience taught her about how to live. You’ll discover why everything we have learned through our education system, government, mass media, etc. is the exact opposite of what we should know in order to create a meaningful, joy-filled life.

programme.title: Live Fearlessly with Anita Moorjani
programme.desc: Today, we take a close look at who we really are in order to recognize our purpose, understand our intentions, and recognize our true worth in this world.

programme.title: Live Fearlessly with Anita Moorjani
programme.desc: We live in a fear-based world. In today’s lesson, Anita offers you tools that have been specially created to overcome your fears with love. This is the greatest lesson she learned during her near-death experience when she traveled to the other side. It’s the lesson that saved her life.

programme.title: Live Fearlessly with Anita Moorjani
programme.desc: Today’s meditation will guide you through forgiveness. Of letting go of obstacles and fears that hold you back from living the life you desire to live. By doing so, you’ll be able to forgive everyone who has hurt you in this life, release emotional baggage that may be weighing heavy on you, and step into a new realm of possibility.

programme.title: Teaching the Teachers with Marianne Williamson
programme.desc: Day one explores core teachings from A Course in Miracles: releasing ambition, ego, and grandiosity to become a compassionate presence. Rather than fixing or leading, we learn to hold space, trust divine guidance, and allow true healing and spiritual transmission to unfold.

programme.title: Teaching the Teachers with Marianne Williamson
programme.desc: Day 2 of Teaching the Teachers explores the core teaching that only love is real and fear is illusion. Not a religion, the Course offers a non-dogmatic spiritual path that can complement other teachings and invites surrender to a higher power for true healing.

programme.title: Teaching the Teachers with Marianne Williamson

programme.title: El Aguila Descalza
programme.desc: Un hombre idealista y soñador, trata de resolver los problemas del pueblo mexicano, principalmente de la clase trabajadora, pero muy a su manera de pensar, logrando resolverlos de tal manera, que además de hacrlo reir, lo hará reflexionar

programme.title: La Formula de Rasputin
programme.desc: En una vecindad de la gran metrópoli, Don Otilio, boticario de mucha fama, descubre un remedio para los males cardiacos, que aumenta el ritmo del corazón. Rasputín, habitante de la misma vecindad y dedicado a sacar dinero vía limpias y procedimientos esotéricos, busca crear un elixir exótico para ayudar a sus clientes, pero no conduce mas que a reclamos y amenazas de quienes lo compran. Don Otilio accidentalmente ingiere su propio remedio, pero tiene un paro cardiaco y cae fulminado, todos ayudan y Rasputín es presionado para que intervenga y cure a Don Otilio. solo se le ocurre darle el elixir exótico, la combinación de estas dos formulas revive a Don Otilio y se crea el súper elixir que genera una gran noticia a nivel mundial.

programme.title: Día de Gracia El Shaka
programme.desc: Zona controla el tráfico en su territorio a través de “Radio Buchón”. Atila y “El Potrillo” se encargan de que las órdenes de arriba se cumplan. Chano esta a cargo de entregar la mercancía a Zona y sus asociados.

programme.title: El Destazador
programme.desc: Everardo, famoso líder obrero de la industria de la carne, es victima de un complot político para asesinarlo. El atentado se efectúa el día señalado y a la hora prevista y sus enemigos creyéndolo muerto disfrutan de sus bienes, pero lo que ellos no saben es que el esta vivo con una identidad diferente y lo apodan “El Destazador”

programme.title: Oasis: Standing on the Edge of the Noise
programme.desc: Oasis performs an intimate rehearsal set at Black Island Studios, featuring tracks from Dig Out Your Soul alongside classics and rarities.

programme.title: Foo Fighters: Live at Wembley Stadium
programme.desc: Filmed over two sold-out nights at England's largest arena, Live At Wembley Stadium features your favorite Foo Fighters hits, from "Everlong" to "The Pretender," plus special guest appearances by Jimmy Page and John Paul Jones of Led Zeppelin

programme.title: a-ha: The Movie
programme.desc: A candid portrait of pop trio a-ha as they revisit the meteoric rise sparked by “Take On Me” and confront creative rifts forged along the way. From teenage dreams to studio breakthroughs, and the pressures of global fame, the film explores whether Morten Harket, Magne Furuholmen, and Paul Waaktaar-Savoy can repair fractured friendships to step back on stage and forge new music.

programme.title: The Chicks: Top of the World Tour Live
programme.desc: The Chicks, Grammy Award winners, launched their 2003 tour with Top Of The World Tour Live. Enjoy hits like 'Goodbye Earl,' 'A Home,' 'Landslide,' and more.

programme.title: Incubus: Look Alive
programme.desc: Incubus performs live on the Light Grenades Tour, featuring a Chicago concert and behind-the-scenes moments from life on the road.

programme.title: Lost Evenings VI: Night 4 – Greatest Hits
programme.desc: Frank Turner & The Sleeping Souls close out Lost Evenings VI in Anaheim with a sold-out, career-spanning set packed with fan favorites, sing-alongs and candid moments. Highlights include “1933,” “Recovery,” “The Next Storm,” “Miranda” and “Little Changes,” capping four nights of music and celebration.

programme.title: Ice Nine Kills: I Heard They Kill Live 2
programme.desc: Watch I Heard They Kill Live 2, a live Ice Nine Kills concert film captured at Thanx-killing 2022 in Massachusetts.

programme.title: Urzila Carlson: It’s Personal
programme.desc: Urzila Carlson performs her stand-up special filmed in Brisbane, delivering sharp humor and personal stories from her global tour.

programme.title: a-ha: True North
programme.desc: 90km above the Arctic Circle, Norway's very own a-ha recorded their first collection of music since 2015's Cast in Steel. "True North is a letter from a-ha, from the Arctic Circle, a poem from the far north of Norway," says Magne Furuholmen. Accompanied by a film, the conceptual collection combines the band's visions and the talent of Norwegian orchestra, Arctic Philharmonic.

programme.title: Future Islands: Live From Cat's Cradle
programme.desc: Future Islands stream live from Cat’s Cradle, celebrating 20 years from a room filled with memories.

programme.title: Subhah Agarwal: Airport Pigeon
programme.desc: Subhah Agarwal delivers a deeply personal stand-up special on mental health, blending sharp humor with stories on rock bottom moments, resilience, and unexpected perspectives.

programme.title: Sarah Barthel on Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with Sarah Barthel—singer, songwriter, and one half of platinum duo Phantogram—for a candid conversation about using art to process emotion, the band’s obsessive pursuit of a singular sound, and the lifelong creative bond between Sarah and bandmate Josh Carter. They trace Phantogram’s beginnings (from beat tapes to breakthrough), balancing romance and partnership, channeling real-life heartbreak into “When I’m Small,” coping with family loss, and gearing up for a summer tour with Deftones. Cameos of warmth (including Leroy the dog) and plenty of shop talk on writing, producing, and performing.

programme.title: Forte
programme.desc: Forte challenges outdated notions of success in classical music through the fast-paced narrative of three female artists.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Host Joel Madden sits down with Matt Pryor, vocalist and guitarist of The Get Up Kids, for a conversation about van touring in the ’90s, being labeled “emo,” and how those early years shaped his approach to songwriting. Pryor also discusses his new book, Red Letter Days, capturing life on the road, family, and creativity through the lens of an evolving music scene.

programme.title: Rock Concert Cuts
programme.desc: Concert Cuts is an nonstop live rock, featuring electrifying performances from concerts around the world. From iconic anthems to deep cuts, every episode delivers a fresh mix of artists and songs that are coming to you live, loud, and on stage.

programme.title: Nos Amis
programme.desc: Nos Amis follows Eagles of Death Metal members Jesse Hughes and Josh Homme as they recount their experiences before, during, and after the 2015 terrorist attack at the Bataclan Theatre in Paris. Blending intimate interviews, archival footage, and emotional reflection, the documentary explores trauma, friendship, and the unifying power of rock and roll.

programme.title: Megadeth - Crush The World Tour Live from Buenos Aires – Night 1
programme.desc: Megadeth kicks off a two-night stand at Buenos Aires’ Movistar Arena on the Crush The World Tour. Filmed for Veeps, Night 1 delivers a blistering set of thrash classics and newer tracks, led by Dave Mustaine and fueled by the crowd’s relentless energy.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden interviews Pat Monahan of Train about their success, scoring Begin Again, and the band's upcoming tour.

programme.title: An Evening of Bell House Debuts
programme.desc: Hosted by Chris Gethard, this Brooklyn showcase features emerging stand-ups connecting with a community of rising talent in a live comedy debut series.

programme.title: Michael Clifford: SIDEQUEST LIVE from The Fonda Theatre
programme.desc: Michael Clifford performs his new album SIDEQUEST live at Los Angeles’ historic Fonda Theatre—an intimate, high-energy set with fan interactions, fresh arrangements, and onstage moments with his band. Stream exclusively on Veeps: each PPV ticket includes a 48-hour viewing window; All Access members get extended viewing.

programme.title: GHOST: Rite Here Rite Now
programme.desc: Filmed during the GRAMMY-winning rock band’s sold-out RE-IMPERATOUR finale at the Kia Forum in Los Angeles, Rite Here Rite Now fuses blistering live performance with a haunting cinematic narrative. Led by Papa Emeritus IV and his nameless ghouls, Ghost delivers theatrical rock anthems, eerie storytelling, and striking visuals in this immersive concert film. Combining songs like “Spillways,” “Call Me Little Sunshine,” and “Watcher in the Sky” with a supernatural storyline, the film captures the band’s balance of grandeur, satire, and devotion to spectacle. Includes an exclusive Q&A with Tobias Forge, Alex Ross Perry, and Jim Parsons from the London premiere.

programme.title: Queen: From Rags to Rhapsody
programme.desc: This documentary tells the story of Queen’s journey from a struggling band to the moment they captured the UK’s hearts with what was to become the greatest song.

programme.title: Reggie Watts: Never Mind
programme.desc: Comedian, musician, and improvisational mastermind Reggie Watts takes the stage in Los Angeles for a performance that bends space, sound, and sense itself. Blending stand-up, music, and live looping, Never Mind explores technology, nostalgia, and the absurdity of modern life through spontaneous humor and sonic experimentation. Both futuristic and deeply human, this live special showcases Watts’ singular ability to find rhythm and meaning in chaos.

programme.title: Cheap Trick: Budokan!
programme.desc: Cheap Trick delivers their iconic Tokyo performance, featuring the original Budokan concert broadcast and additional band interviews.

programme.title: Liam Gallagher: Live at Knebworth
programme.desc: Liam Gallagher of Oasis gives 160,000 fans hope through his music at Knebworth. Known as 'the King of Knebworth', he delivers joy.

programme.title: Cypress Hill: Insane in the Brain
programme.desc: Cypress Hill tells the story of their unique sound rooted in authenticity. Director Estevan Oriol uses archival footage to explore the band's lasting legacy.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Andrew McMahon discusses his journey in music, from being a child to an artist, and his experience with Drive Through Records.

programme.title: Sammy Hagar presents Best of All Worlds
programme.desc: Sammy Hagar presents 'Best of All Worlds' live from Dolby Live at Park MGM. Michael Anthony, Joe Satriani, and Kenny Aronoff join for a career-spanning show.

programme.title: 311 Day 2024 Live from Las Vegas: Night 1
programme.desc: 311 performs a 2+ hour set of fan favorites and surprises live from Park MGM in Las Vegas, celebrating 311 Day with an unforgettable Night 1 experience.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Australian singer, songwriter, and drummer G Flip joins Joel Madden to talk about their rise from session musician to chart-topping solo artist. They discuss growing up in Melbourne, the success of their #1 ARIA album, life in Los Angeles, and lessons learned from years of touring. The conversation also dives into creativity, manifestation, and how G Flip found confidence in their artistry, identity, and marriage.

programme.title: Good Charlotte: Live at Brixton Academy
programme.desc: Good Charlotte performs live at Brixton Academy, delivering hits from The Young and the Hopeless in a high-energy concert.

programme.title: Hanson: Underneath Experience Tour – Night 1 (Acoustic)
programme.desc: Hanson opens their two-night Underneath Experience Tour with an intimate acoustic performance at The Belasco in Los Angeles, celebrating the 20th anniversary of their landmark 2004 album Underneath. The set blends reimagined hits and deep cuts including “Strong Enough to Break,” “Stories,” and “When You’re Gone,” along with early fan favorites like “A Song to Sing.” Between harmonies and heartfelt stories, the brothers reflect on the album’s creation, early tours, and their enduring connection with fans.

programme.desc: Dive into an eclectic mix of the most iconic tracks from the '70s to today, and discover the hits that defined generations.

programme.title: Your Pulse Of Metal
programme.desc: Sync your heartbeat to the complex rhythms of the underground. This collection dives into technical mastery and hidden gems that push your adrenaline. If you’re ready to feel the music in your veins, we’ve got the tracks.

programme.title: Manic Ritual
programme.desc: Lose yourself in the flickering shadows of distortion. A hypnotic sequence of sonic violence and dark imagery designed to unsettle the soul. Bow to the heavy. Welcome to the Manic Ritual.

programme.title: Thrash Metal Attack
programme.desc: Pure, unadulterated speed and fury! Experience blistering shred solos, aggressive riffing, and neck-snapping rhythms. Turn up the volume and brace yourself for an unstoppable wave of high-octane thrash metal chaos!

programme.title: The Home of Heavy
programme.desc: Step into the headquarters for everything that shakes the earth. From the pillars of the classics to the pioneers of the new era, this is where the heart of metal beats loudest. This is where you belong.

programme.title: Rock Bottom
programme.desc: Found your new baseline. Rock Bottom digs deep into the rawest hard rock and alt-anthems. We’re hitting the floor with heavy riffs and soulful grit—no shovels required, just volume. This is the foundation of everything that kicks.

programme.title: Together We Rise
programme.desc: A tribute to the global brotherhood that refuses to fit in. This collection celebrates the unity that turns fans into a tribe. In this pit, no one stands alone—together, we are the loudest force on earth.

programme.title: Death Metal Blasts Part 2
programme.desc: Brace for pure sonic devastation! Featuring relentless blast beats, guttural vocals, and razor-sharp riffs, this collection captures the raw intensity and uncompromising brutality of death metal at its absolute peak. Prepare for impact!

programme.title: Metal That Rocks
programme.desc: Where rock 'n' roll swagger meets the weight of metal. This collection bridges the gap, featuring everything from anthemic hard rock to core-shaking classics. It’s loud, it’s proud, and it’s built to move you.

programme.title: Endless Heavyness
programme.desc: Dive into pure power and unrelenting energy. Endless Heavyness is a non-stop wall of sound designed to hit hard and stay loud. No pauses, no compromises—just the most massive tracks to keep the momentum going. It’s not just loud; it’s eternal.
